name: project-switch-in-remote-mode-starts-no-session
description: In remote mode, switching project folders only changes which folder labels read-back. PowerUp starts no session of its own and types nothing into the remote session.
reason: Remote mode drives a session the person is already running. Starting PowerUp's own session would duplicate the work and echo its own hooks back.
source: DESIGN.md v2.1 B 'adoptProject … (built-in mode) restarts the session'; AppState.adoptProject
